title: cryophytum suaveolens
intro: Cryophytum suaveolens, commonly known as "Umbellularia", is a plant species belonging to the family Rutaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and various health benefits.
